title: 판매등록 히스토리 판매등록확정 이후 변경 비교 계약

actions.name: SALES_HISTORY_READ
actions.sideEffect: read-only. Captures live ShipmentDetail+Estimate for the selected OrderYear+OrderWeek only. Does not write Order, Shipment, Estimate, ShipmentDate, or WebProfitReport.

actions.name: SALES_REGISTRATION_CONFIRM
actions.sideEffect: INSERT WebSalesSnapshot(type=REG_CONFIRM) + WebSalesSnapshotRow + WebSalesBaselineConfirm for the selected OrderYear+OrderWeek. Re-confirm allowed (latest SnapshotKey wins). Order/Shipment/Estimate/ShipmentDate/WebProfitReport are not written.

actions.name: SALES_HISTORY_DIFF_AFTER_CONFIRM
actions.sideEffect: read-only diff of confirmed snapshot vs current capture, plus ShipmentHistory after TakenAt. Cross-year same OrderWeek is excluded by OrderYear.

actions.name: SALES_HISTORY_CHANGE_SNAPSHOT
actions.sideEffect: INSERT WebSalesSnapshot(type=CHANGE) + rows when live capture differs from last snapshot. Ledger tables preserved.

crossYearFixture.description: 같은 OrderWeek(예: 33-01)라도 OrderYear 2025와 2026을 섞지 않는다. capture/list/changeLog/confirm 모두 OrderYear+OrderWeek로 한정한다. 2025-33 확정본을 2026-33 기준이나 변경로그에 쓰지 않는다.

dnspyEvidence.source: 웹 전용. nenova.exe에는 판매등록 히스토리/REG_CONFIRM Form이 없다. 캡처 SQL은 ShipmentMaster+ShipmentDetail+Estimate 읽기, 변경로그는 ShipmentHistory 읽기. 쓰기는 WebSalesSnapshot/WebSalesSnapshotRow/WebSalesBaselineConfirm만.
